name: Ice Prevents Crop Growth
summary: Crops planted on soil with an ice block underneath never advance to the next growth stage, so you can freeze a plant at a chosen stage for decoration. Bone meal still advances them.

vanilla_changes.change: Crops with ice below never grow naturally; bone meal still works. Works for modded crops.

editor_notes: Exact position of the ice (directly beneath farmland) is described only loosely in sources.
